code_summary: One independent masked bidirectional Transformer per category, with dataset routing and one selected checkpoint loaded per category. Defaults: 64 positions, 96 hidden units, two blocks, two attention heads, and 0.2 dropout. Context and output item embeddings are separate jointly trained tables, with a jointly trained item bias. Training uses masked-item sampled softmax with 256 uniform negatives, extra weight on the final query mask, AdamW, gradient clipping, and validation checkpoint selection. The predictor writer imports the training architecture and strictly loads each category checkpoint. No ensemble is implemented.
